scripts.test:coverage:all: npm run test:coverage && cd packages/cloudflare/test-project && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:all: npm run test && cd packages/cloudflare/test-project && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run build:workspaces && npm run test:all && npm run lint || /usr/local/bin/terminal-notifier -title "Positronic" -message "Build/Test failed"
scripts.build:watch: tsc --build --watch packages/core packages/spec packages/template-new-project packages/client-vercel packages/gen-ui-components packages/mem0 packages/cloudflare packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tests/tsconfig.json && (cd packages/cloudflare/test-project && npm run typecheck)
